plan.name: Marathon in 3h30: 16-week plan
plan.description: 16 weeks, 5 runs a week, to run a marathon in 3h30 (4:59/km). Written for a VMA around 15.5 km/h. Week 1 is about 41 km; the biggest week reaches 76 km and the longest run lasts 2h40. Every session has its targets: a share of VMA for easy runs and intervals, your goal pace for race-pace work.

cycles.name: Base
cycles.description: Easy volume, short fast reps and strides. The long run grows a little each week. Week 4 is lighter, to absorb the work.

sessions.name: Fartlek
sessions.description: 20 min warm-up, 8 × (1 min fast at 92–97% VMA / 1 min easy), 10 min cool-down.

sessions.name: Easy run
sessions.description: 40 min easy (62–70% VMA).

sessions.name: Easy run + strides
sessions.description: 40 min easy (62–70% VMA), then 6 strides of 20 s: fast but relaxed, walk back between them.

sessions.name: Recovery run
sessions.description: 30 min very easy (60–66% VMA). Slower is fine.

sessions.name: Long run
sessions.description: 1h20 at an easy, even pace (62–70% VMA).
